title: The first group meditation session will be tomorrow morning at 6:00am eastern/3:00am pacific time.
content: To participate turn off the lights and anything that can make noise or otherwise distract you. Focus on your breathe and try to tune into the feeling you get when waking up from a particularly good dream. Hold your attention there for as long as possible. Notice any thoughts that may come up and allow them to fade back into your awareness.
